convertibility_reason: Uses Standard Library .mqh includes (Expert.mqh, SignalMACD.mqh, MoneyFixedLot.mqh) for trading logic and signal generation rather than raw iMACD() calls. The actual entry/exit logic is encapsulated inside CSignalMACD class, requiring understanding of the library's internal behavior to replicate in Python.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: CMoneyFixedLot: negative Percent=fixed lots, positive Percent=deposit fraction; here Percent=10.0 so uses deposit fraction with Lots=0.1 as minimum

custom_logic_notes: Entry/exit logic is fully delegated to CSignalMACD from the Standard Library. The standard CSignalMACD uses OpenLogicMethod=2 (intersect) by default: long when MACD histogram crosses above signal, short when crosses below. CExpert manages position lifecycle including reversal closes. Expert_EveryTick=false means signals are evaluated on new bar only. SL/TP values (90/110) are in points and the Standard Library CExpertSignal typically handles 5-digit adjustment internally via _Point, so no manual digit adjustment is needed in this EA code.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate CSignalMACD logic: compute MACD(fast=12, slow=24, signal=9) on close prices, generate long when MACD main crosses above signal line, short when crosses below. SL=90 points, TP=110 points. Position sizing: CMoneyFixedLot with Percent=10.0 means lot size = max(0.1, 10% of free_margin / margin_per_lot). No trailing stop. Trade once per completed bar. The Standard Library's CExpertSignal uses previous bar values (shift=1) for crossover detection, so use bar[1] vs bar[2] for signal comparison. Must handle 5-digit broker point adjustment: SL/TP in points already (not pips), so 90 points = 9 pips on 5-digit or 90 pips on 4-digit depending on broker convention.
